source_name: Newmont 2024 Sustainability Report
notes: Concurrent reclamation in 2024. Exceeded target of 162 ha. D-natural constraint evidence: land disturbance and progressive closure are irreducible physical obligations of Phase 1.

source_name: Newmont 2024 Sustainability Report
notes: Customer audits completed at Ahafo South (Ghana), Lihir (PNG), Yanacocha (Peru). No major non-compliance reported. D-institutional confirmation: LBMA Responsible Gold Guidance compliance is verified by customer audits at the mine level — the D-institutional burden of the LBMA standard extends upstream to Phase 1, not only to Phase 4 (Refining).

source_name: Newmont 2024 Sustainability Report
notes: 194 of 812 responding suppliers (from 1040 screened) flagged for higher human rights risk. 78% response rate. C-parameter: supplier network integrity and due diligence depth. Indicates 24% of supplier base carries elevated human rights exposure — structural C-fragility at Phase 1.

source_name: Newmont 2024 Sustainability Report
notes: 30 cyanide-related spills in 2024. 33% decrease from 2023 in spills containing >50 mg/L WAD CN (the higher-risk threshold).
